joins.events: events.ticket_id = durable_workflows.wid (the intake writes events with ticket_id = wid, factory.ps1 line 230), ORDER BY ts, id
joins.ticket: tickets.id = durable_workflows.wid, opportunistic (may be null — the intake does not create a ticket row)

limits: No tool definitions: AgentConfig.tools is omitted — durable_steps carries no tool list (the harness name is in the instruction/description). R3 may enrich it from the harness.
No model identity per turn: AQuA's AgentConfig has no per-turn model field; active_model is carried in provenance only.
No token counts, no latencies: factory.sqlite records no token or duration columns; nothing is invented.
No system instructions: durable_steps carries no per-agent instruction text; the AgentConfig.instruction is the generated 'Worker V5 — Compagnon <agent> (harness <harness>)' line.

steers_json is not mapped into the conversation: steering directives are recorded per step in the DB but have no AQuA counterpart; they are not copied into provenance.steps (only replay_policy/attempts are). A future revision may surface them as provenance metadata.
writer_locks, durable_docs, handoffs are not read: they are coordination state, not trace content.

Failure vocabulary is token-based (fail/error/timeout/abort/crash) because the intake writes 'running'/'paused'/'interrupted'/'asking' and the terminal vocabulary is written by the execution loop, not the intake — an unseen terminal spelling that contains none of those tokens classifies as 'unknown', never as success.

AQuA's TrajectoryStatus (ingested/partial/truncated) is about ingestion completeness, not success/failure — the workflow verdict lives in provenance.verdict and in the turns' content, not in a TrajectoryStatus.

mapping_rules.empty_step: step with neither task nor output and no failure signal -> no turn emitted; recorded in provenance.steps with emitted_as_turn=false
mapping_rules.events_are_milestones: events table rows -> aspace_provenance.events (journal), never conversation turns
mapping_rules.failure_is_function_response: step status failure-like (contains fail/error/timeout/abort/crash) -> function_response part named 'tool_error' (the name AQuA's own OTEL converter assigns to a runtime failure, trace_converter.py:746), response = {error: status, step_key, agent, attempts}; appended to the model event, or its own model event when there is no output
mapping_rules.no_steps_workflow: workflow with no steps -> agents = {}, turns = [] (emitted, not silently dropped)
mapping_rules.one_step_one_turn: durable_steps row -> one ConversationTurn (turn_index = position, turn_id = wid:step_key), in seq order
mapping_rules.one_workflow_one_trace: durable_workflows row (by request_id) -> one EvalCase; eval_case_id = request_id
mapping_rules.output_is_model_event: step.output -> model-role event, author = step.agent, text part
mapping_rules.task_is_user_event: step.task -> user-role event, text part (the instruction the worker received)
mapping_rules.timestamps_verbatim: all timestamps pass through verbatim (ISO-8601 'o' format from the factory)

mission: D-N052 R0 — acte §D1 (source de traces locale factory.sqlite) + §D15 (définition de l'agent observé)

output.format: JSONL — one line per workflow, one workflow = one trace = one EvalCase-shaped object

agent_data.agents: {agent: {agent_id, instruction, description}} — one entry per distinct step agent; {} when the workflow has no steps

events.author: "user" for the task event; the step agent for the output/failure event
events.event_time: step updated_at, ISO-8601 verbatim (factory.ps1 writes Get-Date -Format 'o')

turns.turn_index: position of the turn in agent_data.turns (0-based, positional — build_bundle indexes by position, bundles.py:109-118)

aspace_provenance.events: [{phase, actor, verdict, detail, ts}] — journal milestones, NOT conversation turns
aspace_provenance.note: V5 extension block — R3 strips it before constructing the SDK EvalCase (pydantic ignores unknown fields by default, but the strip is explicit)
aspace_provenance.steps: [{step_key, seq, agent, harness, status, writer, worktree, hc_address, replay_policy, attempts, updated_at, emitted_as_turn}]
aspace_provenance.ticket: ticket row when tickets.id = wid, else null
aspace_provenance.verdict: "success" | "failure" | "in_progress" | "unknown" — V5-side classification from workflow + step statuses (see README §4)
